normal.label: Standard Normal
normal.description: Independent N(0, 1) observations; the sample mean is normal for every n.

uniform.label: Continuous Uniform
uniform.description: Independent Uniform(0, 1) observations; bounded and symmetric but not normal.

exponential.label: Exponential(rate = 1)
exponential.description: Independent exponentially distributed observations with strong right skew.

poisson.label: Poisson(lambda = 1)
poisson.description: Independent event counts with a discrete, right-skewed population.

binomial_small.label: Binomial(size = 5, p = .10)
binomial_small.description: Independent, highly discrete and right-skewed observations.

cauchy.label: Cauchy(location = 0, scale = 1)
cauchy.description: Independent observations with no finite mean or variance; the usual CLT does not apply.

dependent_machine.label: Dependent machine-failure process
dependent_machine.description: An AR(1)-style dependent process: Gaussian correlation rho = .80 is transformed to exponential marginals.

nonidentical_bernoulli.label: Non-identical Bernoulli process
nonidentical_bernoulli.description: Within each sample, Bernoulli probabilities vary linearly from .50 to .90.

mixture.label: Two-component mixture
mixture.description: 90% N(0, 1) and 10% N(5, 1), an asymmetric population with a separated minority component.
